reason: Steel and cargo mesh suggest a rigid, load-spreading surface for the soft crossing.
expectation: They should form a supported traction mat or bridge section.

alternatives.reason: I could check what the crossing accepts first.

effect: The steel and mesh formed stiffened traction panels, ready to support the crossing.
reaction: The load-spreading explanation makes the construction feel physically sensible.
reason: The panels should provide a firmer surface over the soft wash.
expectation: The panels will be laid across the soft ground to support the rover's wheels.

effect: The panels are in place, and the next goal is to take the rover across.
reaction: The supported approaches clarify how the panels can carry the wheels.
reason: The winch and sound rock anchor suggest securing the rover before crossing.
expectation: The winch will be secured to the rock to assist the rover across.

effect: The winch is anchored to sound rock, ready to assist the crossing.
reaction: The aligned recovery line makes the crossing plan clearer.
reason: The anchored winch and supported panels appear to be the prepared means of taking the rover across.
expectation: The rover will cross on the panels with the winch providing assistance.

effect: The rover crossed successfully, and the supported route remains available for the return trip; the chapter is complete.
reaction: The controlled crossing was a satisfying payoff to the preparations.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building and laying the traction panels was most worthwhile: the explanation of stiffened mesh and supported ground made the load-spreading solution understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Anchoring the winch was sensible but fairly predictable after the panels were in place; it added less discovery than their construction.

surprise.text: The explanation that the short panels rested on prepared approaches and supported ground clarified that they were not simply bridging the whole wash unaided.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the panels, anchor and controlled crossing each had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the physically grounded crossing was satisfying, and I am curious what the farther ice core will reveal.
